metadata.name: Press a key on a web page
metadata.author: recued-core
metadata.description: Use “Press a key on a web page” in Recued. Press a key in an element of a page, by its ref or text: Enter sends a field's form or a chat message, Escape closes a dialog; also Tab, arrows, Space or a shortcut like Control+Enter. Asks you first, unless you've allowed it on that site. Presses nothing if the page changed since inspected. Answers what changed.

key.help: The key to press: Enter, Escape, Tab, Space, Backspace, Delete, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, F1 to F12, a letter or a digit, after any of Control, Meta, Alt and Shift joined with + (Control+Enter, Shift+Tab).
key.label: Key

ref.help: The ref of the element, such as e12, from the latest inspection of this page. Leave it empty when passing a selector or a text.
ref.label: Element

page.help: The page handle from List browser tabs, Open a web page, a read, or what a click or Act on web pages answered, copied exactly; not an address. A page that has reloaded or gone to another address has a new handle: a click or Act that loaded it answers it, so use that; else read the page by its address for it.
page.label: Page

text.help: Or what the element shows or is called on the page, as an inspection names it, such as Search Wikipedia or Sign in. Leave it empty when passing a ref.
text.label: Element by its text

selector.help: A CSS selector for the element instead of a ref, such as body for a shortcut of the whole page. Leave it empty to name it by ref.
selector.label: Element by selector
